title: WeakMap notes

blocks.md:
## Notes you do not own

`WeakMap` keys must be objects. When the key is garbage-collected, the entry can go. You cannot iterate a WeakMap — that is the point.

A string like `"fox"` cannot be a key.

The desk remembers `"keep"` on a route object it does not own. When that route is gone, the note can vanish with it.

blocks.promptMd: A WeakMap key can be the string `"fox"`?
A WeakMap key can be the string `"fox"`.
blocks.explainMd: Keys must be objects (or symbols in a WeakMap of objects). A string is not allowed.

blocks.promptMd: > `noteOf(route)` reads a WeakMap. Store `"keep"` on `{}` and print it.

hintLadder.md: Use `WeakMap`, not `Map`, so the hidden check can see the type.
`notes.set(route, "keep")` stores the string on that object key.

description: Notes that do not keep an object alive after you let it go.
